notablePrerequisites: Coveted Jewel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Coveted Jewel to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Coveted Jewel.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.
